title: Fppf covering family of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ and $(X_i)_{i\in I}$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], indexed by an arbitrary set $I$, and let $f_i:X_i\to X$. The family is an fppf covering if every $f_i$ is flat and locally of finite presentation on compatible etale scheme charts [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties], and the family is jointly surjective on field-valued point classes [def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family]. Equivalently, the union of the images $|f_i|(|X_i|)$ is all of $|X|$. The index set and individual covering members may be empty; no nonemptiness or finiteness restriction is imposed.
